nom: Eucerin Radiant Tone Eye Cream Dark Circle Corrector

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report the cream is moisturizing and hydrating under the eyes, with one saying it addressed both dark circles and dryness and another's husband noting more hydrated skin without oiliness.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers generally report no irritation, no breakouts and no burning, though one sensitive-leaning user did note irritation every other day and another experienced early burning that subsided.
segments.mature: Reviewers describing fine lines, wrinkles or aging skin report softer-looking lines and some crease-filling effect, with one noting concealer now creases into new fine lines she attributes to insufficient moisture.

concerns.aging: Several reviewers report visibly softer or blurred fine lines and a smoother, more youthful under-eye look after regular use; one reviewer instead noticed new fine lines cracking her concealer and found the cream not moisturizing enough.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the cream as hydrating, lightweight and quickly absorbed without greasiness; a small number found it merely average or wished for more moisture despite liking the texture.
concerns.redness: No reviewer specifically reports redness as a concern addressed or caused by the product.
concerns.barrier: Not directly discussed; a few mention no irritation or burning, implying no barrier disruption, but this is not framed as a barrier concern.
concerns.spots: Reviewers focus on dark circles rather than spots; several report noticeable brightening and fading of dark circles within one to three weeks, while two report no visible difference after several weeks of use.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer reports developing milia around the eyes after two weeks and stopping use; another with sensitive skin reports no new breakouts from this eye cream despite past reactions to other eye creams.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer notes the product did not make her skin oily despite her face normally reacting that way to products; her husband likewise reports no oily or sticky feeling.

aspects.libelle: Product pills or balls up on skin
Difficult to fully absorb, sits on top of skin
Slight tint or shimmer brightens instantly
Packaging with squeeze tube and screw cap

extraits.texte: I don't have crazy dark circles but I decided to give this a try. With just two weeks of use, I did not see any progress. But I have noticed that I started to get milia around my eyes. I have since stopped using it.

I wanted to love this because it feels nice going on, is gently illuminating, and most importantly doesn't burn like so many illuminating undereye creams. unfortunately it is very prone to pilling. it was extremely incompatable with the sunscreen I was using when I first got it, and did improve when I went back to my favorite sunscreen but still pills up a bit throughout the day if I wipe or rub the area around the eye at all. I decided not to return it because I otherwise do enjoy using it, but will not be repurchasing and wouldn't reccommend it to others.
I've been trying this for about a month and unfortunately I haven't seen any difference. It also irritates my skin every other day, so I decided to stop using it.
I have really dark circles and dry skin under my eyes. This is one of the few products that takes care of both. Lots of other products bother my eyes. This one does not.

I have sensitive skin and am always nervous about trying new products, especially around my eyes, but I had no issues using this eye cream! I love the applicator and how cooling it is. I have always had dark circles and this product has definitely brightened under my eyes, it's hydrating and most importantly has not irritated my skin at all. I'm excited to keep using it!

I usually have problems with face products making my skin oily even though my skin acts dry after I wash it. But this didn't do that at all! My undereyes are especially dry, definitely noticing signs of aging there. Lightened up dark areas I'm getting as my skin is aging. Seeing results only 2 weeks in but I'm excited to continue using this product! I received this product free as part of a promotion,but I'll definitely continue to purchase it !!

This eye cream is very gentle and hydrating! I have somewhat sensitive skin, and several eye creams have caused break outs in the past, but this one did not at all. It did improve the look of my fine lines and dark circles. It is fragrance-free and worked well for my sensitive skin. Overall, I'd definitely recommend it!
